purpose: Establish a defensible real serving/control MVP, not optimize until MPC wins.
lineage: Gateway-only nominal unqualified controller of Native vLLM serving; not Native14/G06/G16 qualification.

deliverables.A: Verified gateway/instrumentation/replay/CPU resume evidence is independent of Native success.
deliverables.B: Native closed-loop validation requires every qualification, comparison, reproduction and independent audit gate; no success claim before all pass.

hardware.exclusive_preflight: Both existing Mayor/component locks, no foreign GPU workload, no unresolved ownership marker; all owned process identities accounted for after each stage.

backend.optimization_rule: Keep the same normal backend optimizations for every arm; no disabling graphs/compilation just to ease startup or improve an MPC comparison.
backend.identity_proof: Actual launch argv/config, package/source provenance, local asset hashes and advertised model alias must be captured. CLI help or a directory name is not running-backend proof.
backend.lifetime: Use the simplest accepted two-service ownership scope: restart engine and gateway for each episode, with identical backend configuration and recorded startup/warmup/drain/cleanup wall time. No persistent unowned backend or gateway restart outside the owner.

gateway.tokenizer_identity: Bind actual verified tokenizer fingerprint; require tokenizer_available and zero character-fallback requests.
gateway.queue: Cost admission rejects rather than introducing a new frontend queue. Backend FCFS is shared by all arms.
gateway.static_setup: Fixed cap is the startup MAX_ADMITTED_COST, installed before warmup/offers and held through final drain; no MPC loop, solver delay or synthetic controller overhead.
gateway.dynamic_initial_cap: Train-selected cap for evaluation; qualification probe separately declares initial cap 32.

workload.kind: Synthetic offered workload executed on real GPU; not an Azure/OOD/generalization holdout.
workload.eval_replay: Measurement harness converts once using the same real tokenizer after controller/config freeze. Controller never receives the tape, future rows or regenerated Eval offers.
workload.warmup: Three fixed requests, one per prompt class 256/1024/3072, identical for every arm, excluded from offered metrics but included in setup wall time.
workload.scheduling: Same absolute host-monotonic offered start for client and controller. Preserve actual send lag and every offered fate; never retime skipped/late requests.

controller.forecast: Frozen Train-only 88/5 rate and mark histogram; distinct forecast RNG; no online refit or Eval future. Record actual realized CausalScenario inputs. The uncalibrated rolling stationary 15-second forecast can extend beyond the public five-second workload; disclose this model limitation.
controller.planning: Three 1-second slots, eight complete paths over caps 16/32; one nominal realization per decision; MPC and OneMove use the same generator, objective and compute/actuation contracts.
controller.one_move: At most one planned transition, including the received-budget prefix, per horizon; replanning does not mean only one change per entire episode.
controller.objective: Unqualified model-resolved-success TTFT<=0.5 count with existing hold/switch/budget/path tie-breaks; not the measured natural SLO objective.
controller.tail: Stop replanning after the declared control episode; retain last cap through request drain.
controller.guards: No relaxing version/source/clock/expiry/pending fencing or precommit ledger checks to obtain a successful action.
controller.owner_process: Use one isolated cooperating Linux process with in-process client/controller work and exactly the two owned service roots. No unrelated child creation; no universal owner-crash cleanup guarantee. Bind the exact preregistered locks and verify STOPPED/known-gone receipts after each episode; retain poison and halt on uncertainty.
controller.authority: Separate default-OFF nominal operator permit bound to actual controller source/protocol/run/clock; no fabricated Native calibration permit.

stages.purpose: Demonstrate consecutive real control cycles and an actual admission-boundary effect. Not a performance comparison.
stages.trace: First five already-tokenized Train rows of measured class 3072, all offered at 1.25 seconds in a separate five-second engineering probe. Immutable input results/mpc-native-r24/reviews/resume-p0-probes02/inputs/admission-boundary.json, SHA256 6d938ba18240f3e0f8cb677064849a73316ee7a8dc918526c68cba37f02da6be.
stages.successor_reason: The original four-request probe cannot cross cap16 even if every request overlaps under the proposed default CostSpec. Preserve its bytes, do not run it as admission-behavior qualification. Five largest available Train requests are the conditional minimum; actual CostSpec and reservation overlap still require proof.
acceptance: Real Native requests with preserved stream outcomes.
At least two consecutive fully timestamped observation, realized prediction, planning, actual first-action application and fresh reobservation cycles.

At least one changed applied action demonstrably affects a real admission/rejection decision; match request and control budget versions and reconstruct reserved cost from the ordered owner ledger. Planner output, a cap ACK, sampled state or hold-only execution is insufficient.
Actual application timestamp within original entry/source/permit bounds.
No unresolved command or ownership fate at completion.
stages.failure_rule: Preserve failure/inconclusive outcome. No seed search or guard weakening; diagnose a concrete issue before a new preregistered successor.

stages.purpose: After Native qualification passes, empirically select the strongest supported static cap on Train only, before Eval.
stages.advance_only_if: Raw finish reason, stream completion/error, real clocks, tokenization, budget, common resources and required natural SLO fields validate.
stages.freeze: Commit selection and all evidence before any Eval; exhaustive only over supported caps 16/32, not a global capacity claim.

stages.purpose: Measure actual MPC, strong OneMove and static references after closed-loop qualification; neutral or negative results are valid.
stages.train_selected_fixed: Alias to the cap frozen on Train; never select the better Eval cap after observing results.
stages.FIFO: A verified FCFS/static32 reference is explicitly an alias, not a fourth distinct algorithm. Without actual backend configuration proof, label unverified.
stages.stopping: Exactly two predeclared rounds; no rerunning to improve ranking. Failed episodes stay in the table.
stages.uncertainty: Two repetitions of one 104-offer synthetic tape are descriptive, correlated workload replays, not evidence of population significance or robust p99 superiority.

scoring.rule: Unchanged score_http natural rule; no TTFT-only substitute and no invented finish reason.
scoring.denominator: All offered requests, with all failure/rejection/not-launched/unknown fates.
metrics: TTFT p50/p95/p99 from scheduled and sent origins
scoring.quantiles: Report n/ranks/sample-maximum flags, conditional selection bias and separate missing-first operational penalties; no identified survival-quantile claim.
scoring.wall: Actual common arm-setup start through final drain/cleanup, plus separately labeled offered-cohort rates. Missing full wall stays null, not a hidden denominator change.

failure_and_stop.preserve: Raw successful and failed artifacts, exact sources/argv/configuration/metrics and local Git commit; private auth/permit material never published.
no_claims: Native Closed-loop MPC Validated before all B gates pass
failure_and_stop.P0_stop: After verified scoped resume claims, move speculative model/benchmark improvements to P1/P2 rather than delay completion.
